sloka: नाभ्यभाषत कैकेय्यिम् मुहूर्तम् व्याकुलेन्द्रियः ।प्रैक्षतानिमिषो देवीम् प्रियामप्रियवादिनीम् ॥२-१२-५२॥
transliteration: nābhyabhāṣata kaikeyyim muhūrtam vyākulendriyaḥ ।praikṣatānimiṣo devīm priyāmapriyavādinīm ॥2-12-52॥

translations.english: The unhappy king intently fixed his gaze at his beloved queen speaking unpleasant words charged with grief and anguish, unpleasant to the heart like the dreadful thunderbolt.
